params.message:
Flatten the handover panel to belang, who takes over, what to know

The panel mixed new input, earlier notes and properties in one column,
with two near-identical rows of colleagues (who carries it today, who
takes it over), a group picker and two checkboxes. It now asks three
things in the order the table goes through them, with Bewaren under
them and what was told before below.

- Who takes over is a property of the node (relation_tags.takers),
  filled from the latest note that named somebody. It shows in the
  panel when it opens, in the Bespreken list and in the graph.
- Group, carrier and the risk/habit tags are no longer asked. Stored
  values stay and are still exported; their filters and the colour by
  group are gone.
- Red in the graph now means told about with nobody named to take it
  over; Bespreken counts those relations. Its agenda puts high
  importance first.
- A note records where it came from (source, source_ref), so notes
  taken from a recorded conversation can hang off the same anchors and
  show in the same panel.
